items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 15:1
items.html: The correction of all the levels of Atzilut that were permanently corrected in them is considered, relative to Nekudim in their Gadlut, only relative to the Nefesh of NRNHY alone. Thus all the Gadlut that ZA attains in Atzilut is only the phase of Nefesh, relative to what he had in the Gadlut of Nekudim. Accordingly, at the time of his Ibur, when he has only the phase of Nefesh of his whole Partzuf, he is then, relative to Nekudim, only one part in a hundred, which is the secret of the Challah of the world of Nekudim, since even at the time of his Gadlut he has in Atzilut only one part in ten. As above. (Item 24).
